card.name: Danish registry and Denmark study mentions
card.fires_on: The word right after Danish or inside Denmark-related text, such as "National" in "Danish National Registry" or a year digit in a Denmark cohort study. Also the U in DTU, the Technical University of Denmark.

modes.label: After Danish
modes.description: The word "National" following "Danish" in a registry study of NSAID-treated patients.
modes.example: In a Danish<< National>> Registry study of patients with heart failure,

modes.label: Denmark cohort text
modes.description: A digit inside a year range in a Denmark-wide population study.
modes.example: In a population-based retrospective cohort study covering all live births in Denmark from 1<<9>>96 to 2008

modes.label: Danish institute name
modes.description: The last letter of the abbreviation DTU, a Danish university.
modes.example: Researchers at DT<<U>> Space examine the effects of variations in atmospheric

card.writes: It pushes the model toward Denmark, Copenhagen and Danish words, and away from unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about Denmark or Danish studies and the next word is likely a Danish place or term.
